description: This file implements the GstWrapper class and related factory functions for managing GStreamer objects, including methods for creating and setting GStreamer structures and caps, with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: GstWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to interact with GStreamer structures and caps.

classes.name: IGstWrapperFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating GstWrapper instances.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getGstWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton GstWrapper instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets simple key-value pairs on GstCaps using variable arguments.

methods.name: gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a specified name and initial field.

methods.name: gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets fields on a GstStructure using variable arguments.
